name: Victorian winter gas concession
provider: Victorian Department of Families, Fairness and Housing
summary: 17.5% off gas usage and service costs from May to October for Victorian account holders with a Health Care Card.
key: 17.5 per cent of gas usage and service costs.
who: Gas account holder with a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card or Veterans' Affairs Gold Card
how: Phone your gas retailer and give your concession card details over the phone.
catches: The concession is available over the winter period of 1 May to 31 October each year.
